content: In this section, we present the details about training our neural network. The neural network architecture are implemented using PyTorch framework BIBREF26. The training is performed on a single Nvidia Tesla P100 SXM2. We first run our experiment on BiLSTM, BiLSTM-CNN, BiLSTM-CRF BiLSTM-CNN-CRF using the hyper-parameters mentioned in Table TABREF30. The training and evaluation was done on sentence-level. The RNN variants are initialized randomly from $(-\sqrt{k},\sqrt{k})$ where $k=\frac{1}{hidden\_size}$.
